text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate from eu-west incoming traffic. Smart-router triggered emergency rebalance.
jay: got the page, on it. where's impact matrix?
ana: metrics: 5xx spike at 14:02 UTC, p50 latency up 230ms, p95 1.2s. Affected routes: /v1/generate (eu-west).
mike: replicated in staging with replayed traffic. root cause looks like overloaded economy lane on eu-west GPU pool.
leila: customers seeing errors, support case #2043 from AcmeCorp (enterprise) reporting failed calls.
sam: adding AcmeCorp to incident notes. they're on dedicated routing but fallback hit economy.
jay: plan: 1) temporary tighten per-customer rate limits to 60r/s for fallback lanes in eu-west 2) steer new requests to eu-central economy 3) disable economy-prefetch caching for eu-west to reduce pressure.
ana: I can push a smart-routing policy change: set regional_weight(eu-west,economy)=0.2 -> eu-central=0.7. also add a ttl 15m.
mike: please do canary in inet-cc-az1 first, then scale if OK.
jay: @ana please run command below to patch policy (canary to cluster inet-cc-az1):
```
POST /api/v1/routing/policies/patch
{
  "policy_id": "smart-tier-2",
  "patch": {"region_overrides": {"eu-west": {"economy_weight": 0.2, "ttl": 900}}},
  "canary_clusters": ["inet-cc-az1"]
}
```
ana: patch applied to inet-cc-az1, monitoring.
mike: initial telemetry: 5xx count down 30% in canary, p95 improved 200ms.
leila: support update: AcmeCorp errors reduced but still seeing a small rate. sending RC note.
jay: ok roll to eu-west primary clusters, keeping canary window 5m. also enabling temporary rate limits for anonymous accounts in eu-west: 40r/s.
sam: made note in incident tracker, page updated with customer impact table.
ana: rollout to all eu-west clusters started.
mike: rollout complete. monitoring for 10m.
jay: thumbs. after 15m we should evaluate reverting cache change if stable.
leila: agreed, preparing postmortem template and customer-facing blurb.
incident-bot: Incident greenlight: no active degradation after 15m monitor window. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
jay: closing page, will follow up with RCA tomorrow. :thumbsup:
